blockingIssues.problem: Claims that numbered lockers caused the fall in lost-item reports (asserts a causal link not supported by the source).
blockingIssues.sourceEvidence: The source records that six stations tried numbered lockers in July and lost-item reports fell from 18 to 11, but also notes that staffing and opening hours changed and explicitly states the note does not isolate a cause.
blockingIssues.constraint: The source does not attribute the reduction in lost-item reports to numbered lockers.
